system.name: Cascaded Selective Evaluation
system.one_liner: Judges pairwise LLM outputs with a cascade of increasingly strong LLM judges that escalate when not confident, with a provable guarantee of human agreement.

content.variant_note: a left-to-right cascade of judge cards that each ask whether the judge is confident (yes drops to an evaluation, else moves on, last judge abstains), over a band that explains the check and a band that states the guarantee
content.argues: Starting with a cheap judge and escalating only when its calibrated confidence is low keeps evaluation cheap while the calibrated thresholds guarantee human agreement at the user's risk level.
content.subject: a cascade of judge cards gated by confidence checks, two procedure boxes behind the check, and the guarantee statement

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a cascade as identical cards in a row where a single pictogram grows with each stronger stage, a dotted yes branch drops from each card and a dashed else arrow continues right to a final abstain; then close with the guarantee as a formula box next to the user's parameters.
lessons.suits: Model cascades, routing or escalation schemes with a confidence gate and a formal guarantee that can be stated as one formula.

evidence: escalate to a stronger model only when the previous judge is not sufficiently confident
Given a list of judge models M, we start with a weaker yet cheaper model as an evaluator

summary: The paper gives LLM-based pairwise evaluation a provable guarantee of human agreement. Figure 1 illustrates Cascaded Selective Evaluation. An Input x box with two elided generations enters a row of judge cards: a weaker judge M1 (Mistral-7B), a stronger judge M2 (GPT-3.5) and a strongest judge MN (GPT-4), with a small, medium and large robot icon. Each card checks whether its confidence C(x) is at least its threshold lambda; if yes a dotted branch drops to Evaluate with that judge, otherwise a dashed arrow moves on, and the last judge abstains. Below, Simulated Annotators and Threshold Calibration feed the shared check, and a bottom band states the guarantee P(agreement at least 1 minus alpha) at least 1 minus delta.
summary_zh: 论文为 LLM 成对评估提供人类一致性保证。图 1：输入依次经弱、较强、最强评委，每个评委检查置信度，达标则评估，否则升级，最后可弃权；下方是置信度与阈值来源，底部给出保证公式。
notes: Prior pass counted two panels and stage-chain; kept two titled sections as panels (bold titles, no frames or tints) and used the decision-flowchart variant because the figure is a branching cascade drawn as cards. The symbols were read from the text strings and the preview; the emoji at the user box is rendered as a bitmap.
